# Third-party assets and licences

Everything else in the UI (logo, crests, gift icon, avatar, 3D trophy and ball, all procedural sprites and icons) is original work made for this project
(Python/PIL scripts and Unity primitives). Nothing is taken from FIFA, EA SPORTS or any club.

| Asset | Source | Licence | Commercial use | Where it is | Used in game? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kenney UI Pack 2.0 (Blue and Yellow PNGs, Future Narrow font) | https://kenney.nl/assets/ui-pack | CC0 1.0 (public domain) | Yes, no attribution required | `ThirdParty/Kenney/UIPack`, `ThirdParty/Kenney/Resources/KenneyFutureNarrow.ttf`, `License-UIPack.txt` | Imported only. The font was tried and rejected (too wide-set for this design) so it is not applied. |
| Kenney Sports Pack 1.0 (balls, cards, flags) | https://kenney.nl/assets/sports-pack | CC0 1.0 | Yes | `ThirdParty/Kenney/SportsPack`, `License-SportsPack.txt` | Imported only, not yet used. |
| Kenney Game Icons (white, 1x and 2x) | https://opengameart.org/content/game-icons | CC0 1.0 | Yes | `ThirdParty/Kenney/GameIcons`, `License-GameIcons.txt` | Imported only, not yet used. |

Unused imports can be deleted at any time without affecting the game.

Notes
- Club names and player names in `TeamCatalog` include real ones. Real names are the owners' trademarks and need licences before a store release.
  Royal United and Thunder FC are fictional. The crests for the real-named clubs are original generic shields, not the real badges.
